content.title: Could M&A Be in BNY’s Future? What CEO Robin Vince Says.
content.summary: Bank of New York Mellon is open to acquisitions if the right opportunity arises, but is focused on executing its current strategy, says CEO Robin Vince.  Vince, who was responding to an analyst question during his company’s earnings call, declined to comment on a recent Wall Street Journal article that reported that BNY approached Northern Trust about a potential acquisition.  Acquiring Northern Trust would provide BNY a large wealth management business that caters to ultrawealthy families, but integrating it would be a challenge.
